tools.name: tcc_get_page_summary
tools.description: Read the public heading, answer-first summary, canonical URL and last reviewed date of the page currently open.

tools.name: tcc_go_to_section
tools.description: Scroll the page currently open to one of its own sections and move keyboard focus there. This only moves within the page the visitor is already reading.

sectionId.description: A section identifier returned by tcc_list_page_sections.

tools.name: tcc_list_page_sections
tools.description: List the sections of the page currently open, with the identifier needed to jump to each one.
